description:
Death race in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Combat car shooter with vehicle battles, mission-based racing, destruction & explosions. Drive to survive in Dead Paradise!

Welcome to Dead Paradise — a free combat racing game with car shooter action set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Join the racer's gang and jump into explosive death races on dangerous tracks. No internet needed — play offline anywhere, anytime!

You drive upgraded race cars armed with deadly weapons to destroy your rivals across post-apocalyptic locations. This is more than racing — it's vehicle combat, car battles, and wasteland warfare combined. Speed, action, destruction, explosions, shooting — and above all, the drive to win.

▸ DEATH RACE COMBAT
Race and shoot at the same time. Every track is a death race where your car is your deadly weapon. Combat racing meets car shooter action in apocalyptic battles you won't forget.

▸ POST-APOCALYPTIC WASTELAND
Explore wastelands ravaged by nuclear war. Battle through 90 unique levels across destroyed highways, ruined towns, and desert arenas. Survive the wasteland — fight for fuel, ammo, and glory.

▸ UPGRADE YOUR DEATH CAR
10 unique death cars and monster trucks to unlock. Upgrade missiles, armor, engine, and fuel — increase damage, health, and speed. Build the ultimate combat vehicle for vehicular destruction.

▸ 8 MISSION TYPES — NEVER THE SAME RACE TWICE
Survive the chase: break through enemy patrols and traps to reach your base alive. Grab boosters from defeated rivals to stay alive.
Boss chase: a boss is hunting you down — destroy him and his entire crew. Show no mercy.
Wasteland cleanup: clear the area of enemies and reach the base intact.
Time attack: destroy a set number of bandits AND make it back before time runs out.
Stealth strike: sneak past patrols, blow up the enemy base, escape in the agent's car.
Race against time: grab a car and weapons fast — clean up the zone before the clock hits zero.
Convoy escort: protect the cargo at any cost. Don't let the bandits destroy a single vehicle.
Arena survival: the best racers fight here. Max out your car, your skills, your weapons — and outlast them all to become champion.

▸ EPIC BOSS BATTLES
5 unique end bosses, each driving custom-built war machines. Beat 15 enemy types across challenging missions. Each boss battle is a different combat racing challenge — bring total destruction.

▸ OFFLINE CAR GAMES — NO INTERNET REQUIRED
Play this combat racing game offline. No connection needed for the full death race experience. Perfect for travel, commute, or anywhere with no internet.

GAME FEATURES
- 100 unique death race levels in a post-apocalyptic world
- 8 mission types — chase, boss fights, escort, arena, stealth & more
- 15 enemy types — from raiders to boss vehicles
- 10 death cars and combat trucks to unlock
- 5 epic end bosses with unique war machines
- 4 upgrade systems — missiles, armor, engine, fuel
- Offline gameplay — combat racing without internet
- Action shooter mechanics combined with racing physics

YOUR CAR IS YOUR WEAPON
In Dead Paradise, your race car is built for combat. Mount weapons, reinforce armor, upgrade the engine. Take on rival racers, criminal gangs, and apocalyptic bosses across desert wastelands. This is vehicular combat at its purest — destroy or be destroyed.

PERFECT GADI GAME FOR ACTION FANS
A combat racing experience for fans of post-apocalyptic action, vehicle battles, and death race games. If you love car combat, wasteland racing, and vehicular destruction — Dead Paradise is your gadi game.

Download Dead Paradise today. Rule the wastelands. Become the king of the death race.

Dead Paradise is free to play but contains optional in-app purchases. Unlock all characters and bikes with Google Play Pass.
